notes.title: The Biggest Update Yet...
notes.notes:
[h2][b]1.2.0 - Missions & Skins Update[/b][/h2][p]
[i][b]Do you want more to do?[/b][/i][b]   This update is for you![/b]
[/p][p]There are now [b]MISSIONS[/b] in the game. These include a unique challenge for each level, bombs hidden out of bounds, a quiz about the story, a speedrun through the whole game, and more.
[/p][p]As you complete each mission, you unlock a new [b]BOMB SKIN[/b]. When you beat your high score, your new skin will be visible to everyone in the replay.
[/p][p]Complete all missions to unlock achievements, an especially nice-looking skin, and get featured on the [b]EXPERT PLAYER LIST[/b]!
[/p][p]But that’s not all, check out the list below.[/p][p]Thank you for still playing, and till next time! [/p][p]Eric (LongEcho) [/p][hr][/hr][p]
[b]Features:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Missions – 7 missions in total, now with a menu! They include Ethan's Quiz, unique level challenges, bombs hidden out of bounds, and more.[/p][/*][*][p]Bomb Skins – Unlock skins by completing missions. They are also visible in your replay.[/p][/*][*][p]Time Zones – Splits the level into different time segments so you can compare your timing during the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Expert Player List – Join the list by completing all missions and earning all achievements![/p][/*][*][p]Menu Theme – Choose one of 9 different main menu themes.[/p][/*][*][p]Leaderboards Viewer – View all leaderboards and replays directly from the menu.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Enhancements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Redesigned main and pause menus[/p][/*][*][p]Post-processing & color overhaul, plus performance improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Switch active monitor in settings[/p][/*][*][p]Leaderboards are now fully optional[/p][/*][*][p]Gamma slider now has a wider range[/p][/*][*][p]Added new Settings category: Display[/p][/*][*][p]Various UI improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Hotkeys available in the main menu[/p][/*][*][p]Player sliding is more fun[/p][/*][*][p]Faster and better-looking loading fade[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed many Full Time Speedrun issues[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed duplicated resolution presets in settings[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed occasional incorrect resolution[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where hotkeys were not working[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed key binding setting sometimes missing descriptions on different screen sizes[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed macOS text rendering issues[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bloom sometimes getting out of hand[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Level Workshop mouse drinking invisibility potion at the wrong point[/p][/*][*][p]Updated web-links[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed audio distortion in Level 7[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Level Editor tag buttons being already selected[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed very slow scroll speed in some UI windows
[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p]

notes.title: 1.1.1 - Patch Version
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44527837/27c6efe180aa78dfe6654fbe0133aacceec01201.png[/img]


[b]Enhancements[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed Unity splash screen
[*] Improved camera controller – less clipping
[*] Added reload button to leaderboard screen
[*] Visual and interaction improvements in Levels 1 and 10
[*] Various UI improvements
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Level Editor: Fixed issue where pressing Escape did not unselect all objects; this bug also caused additional issues
[*] Level 10 – Sunlight: Fixed some objects not culling correctly
[*] Replay: Fixed an issue where user replays sometimes failed to load
[*] Fixed log report being saved multiple times
[*] Fixed continue button sometimes starting the previous level instead of the correct one
[/list]

notes.title: 1.1.0 - Replay Update
notes.notes:
This update has been in the works for a long time, even before release. Let me introduce: the [b]REPLAY SYSTEM![/b] 

[b]Features:[/b]  
[list]  
[*] REPLAY: Replay timer results!  
As soon as you install the update, all your NEW best times are uploaded with a replay to the leaderboard, so other people can see how you did — and you might see how you can improve your time even more.  
[/list]  
[b]Enhancements:[/b]  
[list]  
[*] Level 1 - Welcome: Doors can no longer crush you into the ground  
[/list]  
[b]Fixes:[/b]  
[list]  
[*] Level 6 - Temporal Lights: Green block performance fix  
[*] Level Editor: Player damage is visible again  
[*] Level Editor: Fixed bug where the force value of force pad is not loaded correctly  
[*] Level Editor: Bomb performance improvement  
[*] Level Editor: Fixed player sometimes not receiving publish achievement  
[*] Fixed Level Restart Button sometimes breaking the game  
[/list]
